cappers.name: Locked Door MMA
cappers.reasoning: Lock of the night: Umar brings IQ, elite grappling, a sharp striking game that opens his takedowns, and recovers well when clipped; there are levels and he should take over as the fight goes.

cappers.name: Young Pastey
cappers.reasoning: Leg 2 of the 3-unit parlay at -133; believes Umar's relentless takedowns and top control smother Song Yadong for a likely boring five-round decision or late submission, and he won't doubt a Khabib-trained fighter.

cappers.name: KennyOkoyeMMA
cappers.reasoning: Umar is objectively the better and trickier striker with stance switching, great front-leg work and back-taking, making him the more talented fighter; also a parlay leg.

cappers.name: Pure Picks MMA
cappers.reasoning: Umar is the complete fighter with striking, grappling, footwork and speed advantages; Song is athletic but not elite in any single area and falls short against top-level competition. Comfortable using Umar as a parlay leg despite the steep price.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: Umar has the best striking in the division and can dictate both the striking and wrestling; Song will be overly focused on takedown defense and hesitant, plus he overcommits on punches and is slow to react to takedown attempts.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Listed as one of his strong favorites and included in his confident-picks parlay and main card parlay, though he expects a decision rather than a finish.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Near-flawless run with only the Dvalishvili hiccup; despite rooting for Song as a fan, the pick has to be Umar who positions himself for a title shot.

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Loves him as a parlay piece — chain wrestling, back control and scrambles will be too much for Song over 25 minutes.

cappers.name: MMA Lock of the Night
cappers.reasoning: After reviewing tape he thinks Umar can dictate pace, counter Song's aggression with takedowns, and that his chain wrestling and body-lock back rides are too much for Song.

cappers.name: Thegoatpicks
cappers.reasoning: World-class wrestling and top pressure, durable and never been finished; his only loss was to Merab Dvalishvili on wrestling and cardio.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Umar can find takedowns and also outstrike Song, who will be hesitant to let his hands go fearing the shot.

cappers.name: Mark Berry TMA
cappers.reasoning: Umar has Song covered basically everywhere: faster on the outside, kicking advantage, and the wrestling is always there, as shown by how dominantly he out-scrambled Marlon Vera-level grapplers like Batista. Song's only path is a one-off KO.

cappers.name: MMA EXPERTS
cappers.reasoning: Umar's long-range kickboxing, footwork and wrestling threat should let him outwork Song over 25 minutes; doesn't think Song knocks him out or wins on the cards, though the price is very wide.

cappers.name: Fightnugget
cappers.reasoning: Expects Umar to play it safe and lean on grappling for control over five rounds; Song may crack him but Umar recovers, gets takedowns, and wins by decision or submission.

cappers.name: BotmfeederMMA
cappers.reasoning: Umar will chain wrestle and ragdoll Song to a late submission or wide decision; sees no path for Song, but says the main event is too sketchy for a best bet.

cappers.name: THE MMA GURU
cappers.reasoning: Song is strong and physical with a great sprawl and grappling defense that discourages shots, plus a nasty guillotine; Umar has been hurt before and can't damage Song enough to earn respect.

cappers.name: We BET Parlays
cappers.reasoning: Underdog of the week: Song is a violent striker with fight-changing power who only needs one shot, the Dagestani camp fighters have looked human lately, and he has the home crowd in China; only path to a loss is Umar turning it into a wrestling match. Capper said his confidence is a six and the line should be closer to -200/+160.

cappers.name: Big Uncle MMA
cappers.reasoning: Called it the lock of the card: five rounds favors Umar, who averages four takedowns per 15 minutes, absorbs only 1.86 significant strikes per minute, and already went five rounds with Merab Dvalishvili; Song won't bring that grappling pressure.

cappers.name: MMA Lock of the Night
cappers.reasoning: Umar's well-rounded game — long-range striking, countering Song's aggression, and timely takedowns — wins him the scorecards.

cappers.name: MMA Prediction Guru
cappers.reasoning: Umar is the better striker and grappler, can kick at range and time takedowns, and will hold Song down and make it boring for a dominant decision.

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Value play to bring the giant moneyline down; he expects a full five rounds and doesn't think Umar finishes Song.

cappers.name: KennyOkoyeMMA
cappers.reasoning: After his 100+ hour film study he thinks Umar is actually the superior striker, will frustrate Yadong with stick-and-move, mix in wrestling to take the back, and out-strike him fairly comfortably over five rounds, though his finishing ability isn't high so it goes to the scorecards.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Umar has the wrestling/grappling edge plus range and kicking advantages, and should accumulate control time over five rounds as Song fatigues; he calls it a confident pick.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Umar could find a finish but as fights get later he tends to just win rounds rather than hunt finishes.

cappers.name: MMA EXPERTS
cappers.reasoning: Official pick: expects a full 25-minute technical fight with Umar holding a slight lead throughout, predicting a 49-46 unanimous decision.

cappers.name: MMA Husky Hustler
cappers.reasoning: Over 25 minutes Umar should dictate where exchanges happen with takedowns, clinch and fence pressure, banking rounds with control while durable Song survives.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Song won't outgrapple Umar and his takedown defense has only held up against non-grapplers; Umar wins a boring 48-47 grinding decision on the fence.

cappers.name: TheWeasle

cappers.name: The MMA War Room Podcast

cappers.name: The Cage Doctor

cappers.name: Sauce Casual

cappers.name: MMA Moustache

cappers.name: Bedtime MMA
cappers.reasoning: Song poses problems but nobody beats him clean; expects a boring control-time masterclass with Umar's side kicks, question mark kicks and reactive takedowns into back control for a 49-46/48-47 decision.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Expects Umar to take Song down and grind him out for five boring rounds, as Song has faltered in these title-eliminator fights.

cappers.name: Pure Picks MMA
cappers.reasoning: Both cappers lean unanimous decision since Song is durable and tough to finish, though a submission is possible.

cappers.name: MMA OddsBreaker (Adam)

cappers.name: Northwest425

cappers.name: Mark Berry TMA
cappers.reasoning: He should be a pretty dominant decision victor; Umar hasn't finished anyone since the Barcelos KO and doesn't finish top-10 opposition.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He leans to a grinded, boring decision win for Umar.

cappers.name: THE MMA GURU

cappers.name: KennyOkoyeMMA

cappers.name: MMA EXPERTS
cappers.reasoning: Leans yes on the -5.5 spread at -145 since he predicts 49-46, but warns judges can blow a close round and ruin the spread.
